# Common library docs and generated files

These rules apply to `charts/library/common/docs/`, `examples/`, `docs-pages.yaml`, the structure files and the generator scripts. They add to the library rules in [`common-library.instructions.md`](common-library.instructions.md) and the general rules in [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md).

| Path (`charts/library/common/`) | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `docs/` | User documentation, published at <https://trueforge.org/truecharts-common>. Generated from the schema, except `docs/dependencies/index.md`. |
| `examples/**/*.md` | The `## Full Examples` sections of the generated docs pages, one file per page, same path as the page. |
| `docs-pages.yaml` | Lists the docs pages and which part of the values tree each one documents. |
| `complete-values-structure.yaml`, `template-keys-structure.yaml` | Generated lists of the keys used in values files and templates, for the schema coverage check. |
| `stable-legacy-keys.yaml`, `legacy_keys.py` | Keys that charts still set but no template reads, and the helper that leaves them out in `test_schema.py` and `generate_complete_values_structure.py`. |
| `*.py` | Generators and checks for the docs, structure files and schema. |

## Generated docs

- `docs/**` is generated by `generate_docs.py` from `values.schema.source.json` and `schemas/`, except `docs/dependencies/index.md`, which is written by hand (`handwritten: true` in `docs-pages.yaml`, see [`common-library-dependencies.instructions.md`](common-library-dependencies.instructions.md)). Do not edit generated pages by hand.
  - The generator follows every `$ref` from the root schema and builds one tree of real values paths (`workload.$name.podSpec.hostNetwork`, `hostAliases[].ip`). A key that comes from a shared schema file lists every place it is used under "Appears in".
  - `docs-pages.yaml` lists the pages. A page has a `file` (its URL), a `title` and a root: `path` (a values path), `ref` (a schema file, for fragments used in many places) or `roots` (several). Options: `include` (more roots on the same page), `applies` and `parent` (a page for one `type`, see below), `collapse` (show a key as a link to another page), `compact_links`, `overview_only` (a table of the keys) and `handwritten`. A key that is the root of another page becomes a link to that page. Every root key of the schema must be covered by a page.
  - Keys that only apply to some values of `type` carry `x-docs-appliesTo: ["nfs"]` in the schema. They are left out of the page of their parent and shown on the page with the matching `applies`.
  - Change the schema, or `examples/<page file>`, which is added to the end of the page and must start with `## Full Examples`. Other sections may follow it. Text that only exists in a page is lost on the next run.
  - Then run `python3 charts/library/common/generate_docs.py`. List new pages in `docs-pages.yaml`.
  - `python3 charts/library/common/generate_docs.py --check` is run by CI and `run_common_tests.sh`. It fails when the pages are not up to date, a key or page is not covered, a link or anchor is broken (case sensitive), an example file has no page, an example has invalid or duplicate YAML or uses keys, types or values the schema does not allow, or markdownlint reports errors on `docs/` and `examples/` (when `markdownlint` is installed). A block with `# docs-example: partial` on its first line is not checked against the schema.

## Generated structure files

- `complete-values-structure.yaml` is rebuilt on every run from the `common` and `common-test` values files, the `set:` blocks of the `common-test` unittests, and the values files of charts under `charts/stable` and `charts/incubator`. Charts only add keys under root-level keys defined by the library, never new root-level keys.
- `template-keys-structure.yaml` lists the keys the templates read. `generate_template_keys_structure.py` maps `$objectData` in `class/` and `lib/` through `OBJECT_DATA_OWNERS`, by the place of the file; add a file or directory there when you add a template that renders an object. Keys that spawners compute themselves are in `INTERNAL_OBJECT_KEYS`. `generate_template_keys_structure.py --check` fails when the file is not up to date, `./run_common_tests.sh` runs it.
- Regenerate them after changing values or templates:

  ```bash
  pip install PyYAML ruamel.yaml
  python3 charts/library/common/generate_complete_values_structure.py
  python3 charts/library/common/generate_template_keys_structure.py
  ```

- The generated files are not always up to date. Commit only the generated changes that belong to your change. Mention unrelated changes from a generator, or a generator check that already fails, in your summary or PR, instead of fixing them in the same PR.
- `check_complete_values_schema_coverage.py` must report 100% coverage of both structure files, see [Schema checks](common-library-schema.instructions.md#schema-checks).
